About ArBha Consultancy

A Multi-Disciplinary Firm Built on Technical Rigor

Established in 2020, ArBha Consultancy (ABC) is dedicated to delivering comprehensive solutions across engineering, safety, environment, sustainability, and design. Backed by seasoned subject matter experts, ABC partners with a diverse and growing clientele to navigate complex regulatory landscapes, optimize asset integrity, and foster sustainable operational growth.

Reducing Operating Pressure

ABC proactively shoulders the burden of rigorous compliance, risk assessments, structural design validations, and environmental audits (such as National Building Code and fire-safety gap assessments). By managing these critical functions, we relieve administrative and operational strain on leadership teams, allowing you to focus entirely on core business expansion.

NBC & Fire-Safety Gap Audits

Minimizing Operating Costs

Through strategic risk mitigation, thorough hazard identification, and sustainable design integration, ArBha helps organizations prevent costly regulatory penalties, operational downtime, and asset inefficiencies. Proactive resource management and waste minimization strategies further drive down long-term operational overheads.

Penalty & Downtime Prevention

Delivering Timely & Accurate Solutions

Recognizing that time is critical in commercial and industrial operations, ABC leverages deep technical expertise to provide prompt, precise, and actionable recommendations. Whether executing complex finite element analysis, rapid safety walkthroughs, or clear documentation reviews, we ensure meticulous adherence to project timelines without compromising quality.

Rapid FEA & On-Time Turnaround
What We Do

Our Core Services

End-to-end consulting spanning occupational safety systems, environmental compliance audits, and advanced structural engineering.

Pillar 01

1. Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) Consultancy

Proactive industrial safety governance, hazard control, and international management system accreditations.

  • Risk Assessments and Mitigation Strategies
  • Development and Implementation of Safety Programs
  • Workplace Safety Inspections and Audits
  • HAZWOPER (Hazardous Waste Operations & Emergency Response) Compliance
  • Construction Safety Plans
  • ISO 45001 - OHS Management Systems Gap Analysis Audit and Management System Training
  • OHS Management System - Documentation Preparation, Review and Approval
Framework: ISO 45001:2018
Pillar 02

2. Environmental Consultancy

Comprehensive environmental stewardship, regulatory auditing, and sustainability planning.

  • Environmental Impact Assessments (EIAs)
  • Regulatory Compliance Audits for Air, Water, and Waste Management
  • Sustainable Design and Construction Practices
  • Site Remediation Plans
  • ISO 14001 - Environment Management Systems Gap Analysis Audit and Management Systems Training
  • EMS Management System - Documentation Preparation, Review and Approval
Framework: ISO 14001:2015
Pillar 03

3. Structural Design Consultancy

Rigorous structural engineering, code-certified analysis, seismic safety, and advanced FEA simulations.

  • Structural Engineering Services for Buildings, Bridges, and Other Structures
  • Seismic Analysis and Design (IS 1893 & Global Standards)
  • National Building Code (NBC) & Statutory Code Compliance
  • Construction Drawings and Specifications
  • Finite Element Analysis (FEA) for Complex Structural Stress Analysis
Framework: NBC 2016 / IS 456

Strategic Advantage

Why Partner With Us?

Navigating today’s fast-evolving regulatory and industrial landscape demands more than just meeting minimum standards—it requires proactive risk management, operational resilience, and unwavering compliance.

Mitigating Complex Risks & Liabilities

Modern businesses face intricate safety, environmental, and engineering codes (NBC, IS standards, and statutory fire-life-safety frameworks). ABC ensures thorough hazard identification, protecting your assets, personnel, and brand.

Streamlining Regulatory Compliance

Frequent statutory revisions strain internal resources. ABC bridges this gap by offering expert-led audits and actionable recommendations, ensuring seamless alignment with local and national mandates.

Enhancing Operational Efficiency

By outsourcing specialized engineering, safety, and sustainability workflows to dedicated professionals, internal teams are freed from heavy administrative burdens, allowing leadership to focus on expansion.

Optimizing Long-Term Costs

Proactive identification of inefficiencies, safety hazards, and resource wastage prevents costly downtime, regulatory penalties, and reactive asset repairs, delivering a measurable return on investment.

Reliable, Timely Decision-Making

With a proven track record across numerous clients since 2020, ABC provides prompt, precise, and practical solutions that keep projects moving forward without compromising quality or safety.

Integrated Approach

Seamlessly blending safety protocols, environmental controls, and structural design right from project inception rather than treating them as disjointed afterthoughts.

Experienced Professionals

Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) with hands-on industrial, educational, and high-velocity structural analysis experience dedicated to high standards and compliance.

Commitment to Sustainability

Aligning infrastructure and industrial operations with national and international environmental regulations while actively optimizing operational energy and resources.
